name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

vectorStore.description:
If specified, then this is the {@link Genai.Retriever} that will be used by the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine to retrive
similar passages.

numPassages.description:
The number of relevant passages to query the vector store for search results that populate
the grid below the main answer and rationale. This parameter DOES NOT affect either the answer or rationale.
This is typically much higher than executorParams -> numSources which corresponds to the
number of sources retrieved for each hop.

suppressSourceRelations.description:
If true, then source relations will be not be persisted or returned for results when using this config.
This may be useful for cases where the data points to only a single source file.

deploySpec.description:
Configuration for {@link Engine.DeploySpec} for Genai Engines.
Any fields specified here will override the defaults.

modelConfigName.description: Name of {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} that should be used by the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.

chatMemoryConfigName.description: Name of {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ChatMemoryConfig} that should be used by the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine for chat memory (if applicable)

extractionModelConfigName.description: Name of {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig} that should be used by the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine for extraction (if applicable)

executorParams.description: Parameters to be passed to the executor

extractionConfigName.description:
The Extractor config {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.ExtractorConfig} name.
If empty, the extractor step will be skipped.

rerankerConfigName.description:
The Reranker config {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.REA.RerankerConfig} name.
If empty, the reranking step will be skipped.

chatWithFullHistory.description:
Whether to use the full history of chat in REA question answering.
By default, a new standalone question (with sufficient context) is created (re-written) based on the chat history and passed to the LLM.
If this is set to true, the full chat history can be passed to the LLM, along with the latest (non-rewritten) question.

attributionSpec.description:
Spec for {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Util.Attributor#attribute}.
If not set, new attribution with corroboration will not run.

engineThreadPoolSpec.description:
Configuration for {@link Engine.DeploySpec#threadPool} for {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine}.
Any fields specified here will override the defaults.

streamTimeoutSeconds.description: For any response that is streamed, consider it failed after this many seconds.

title:
Configuration of Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine execution.

* To view all currently available configurations by name, use `Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.listConfigKeys()`.
* To view the values set in a specific config, use `Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.forConfigKey({{ NAME OF CONFIG }})`
* To update an existing config,
     1. Retrieve it via `Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.forConfigKey`, set field values as you would with any other Obj
        (e.g. `withFields`), and then call `setConfig()` to persist your changes.
      OR
     2. Set individual fields via `setConfigValue()`
* To create a new config, simply use `Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.make( ... ) with your desired configuration. If you would
  like to reuse most of an existing config, you can
     1. Retrieve the existing config: `var myConfig = Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.forConfigKey("c3DocumentationV6")`
     2. Change the name (so that you do not overwrite the existing config): `myConfig = myConfig.withName(...)`
     3. Update other config values via `with` or `withFields`
     4. Persist your config via `myConfig.setConfig()`
* To set any config as the default for the app, use `Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config.setDefault({{ CONFIG NAME}})`
* Note: only the default Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.Config (set via #setDefault) will affect the behavior of the application.

Note: If you have already started the Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine in your app, you will have to run Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.stop()
after setting the config for the new value to take effect.
